Liam C: Hey team, quick onboarding question: if I see intermittent 504s or token spikes for a customer in prod, who exactly should I contact for each layer? I'm trying to make a one-line cheat sheet (routing, kernel/GPU, model pin/rollback, billing for Dedicated).

Priya N: Welcome Liam! :wave: Nice idea. Here's a one-line owner list we use in the playbook: routing -> eng-runtime, host/GPU/hosts -> infra, alerts/oncall -> eng-sre, Dedicated billing/limits -> eng-platform.

Marco: Adding a bit more detail since you asked about token spikes: if tokens spike but latency is fine, it may be a usage pattern (client). If tokens spike + latency up -> likely batching/KV/cache or capacity. In that case ping infra + eng-runtime.

Liam C: Any exact channels or people to mention? Want to avoid pinging the wrong rotation.

Priya N: Channels: #eng-runtime, #eng-infra, #eng-sre, #eng-platform. For Dedicated billing use eng-platform-saas@redwood.com. Primary oncall rotations are listed in the handbook but short: @eng-sre-oncall (pager covers incident triage), @infra-oncall (host/GPU).

Marco: Quick triage steps you can run before paging: 
```
# check recent 5xxs and traces
redwoodctl logs query --service inference --since 10m --filter "status:504"

# check route config
redwoodctl route get --customer <id> --env prod

# check KV cache hit rate
redwoodctl metrics get kv_cache_hit_rate --customer <id> --window 5m
```

Liam C: Nice. For rollbacks/pinning model variants, who can actually flip the pin? Is that eng-runtime only?

Priya N: eng-runtime owns routing and pin operations. For emergency rollbacks you can request a rollback in #eng-runtime and tag @runtime-oncall. Use the template: 
```
EMERGENCY ROLLBACK: customer=<id> request_id=<rid> reason=<regression/latency/capacity> desired_action=pin:<model>@<version>
```

Marco: Also include example payload + trace id when you page. The bots are configured to attach traces if you paste the request-id.

sre-bot: NOTE: When paging, include request-id, trace-id, sample input and the timestamp. Pages without those add 10m to diagnosis time.

infra-bot: FYI: If you suspect GPU OOMs or host instability, run `infractl host status --zone <z>` and include the top `dmesg` cut. For Dedicated customers, eng-platform will join the ticket for capacity/contract checks.

Liam C: This is perfect. One last: if I need to escalate beyond oncall (postmortem / exec), what is the path?

Priya N: Escalation path: page oncall -> if unresolved after 15m, move to #release-war-room and cc Eng Leadership (eng-leads@redwood.com). For customer-facing incidents, eng-platform + customer success should be CC'd immediately. We try to follow the 3-step: page -> war-room -> exec if 30m+ outage.

Liam C: Thank you! I'll add this to my onboarding doc and share it back. Really helps. :thumbsup:

Marco: Happy to review your doc when ready. Also ping #devex for adding a short card to the onboarding checklist.

sre-bot: REMINDER: Follow incident runner checklist: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/incident-runner (attach links in pages).
